dedupe_keys.name: breitband masterplan steiermark technical rough plan of a nationwide ftth fibre network for styria wms

description: The Breitband Masterplan Steiermark is the Styrian regional government's technical rough plan for a fibre to the home network covering the whole of Styria in Austria. The catalogue entry read on 2026-09-28 through the data.europa.eu interface says the plan was drawn up to prepare a future nationwide fibre supply across municipalities and regions and to exploit synergies, for example with other civil works, and publishes it as a web map service on the regional GIS server under a CC BY 4.0 licence. Coverage is the federal state of Styria. Access is free and the licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it is a planning layer, not a record of built fibre, the date and level of detail of the plan are not given in the entry, and only a WMS is offered, so vector geometry may not be downloadable. It supports capacity planning and network studies, such as comparing planned backbone and access routes with population or with hazard zones in a regional digital infrastructure model. Related record: the Austrian broadband atlas shows current availability.
name: Breitband Masterplan Steiermark: technical rough plan of a nationwide FTTH fibre network for Styria (WMS)
provider: Land Steiermark (Styrian regional government), via data.gv.at and data.europa.eu
